# sustain_alert_policy (Resource)

Who a monitor's or a service's alerts reach, and when.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sustain_alert_channel" "hook" {
  name           = "Ops webhook"
  kind           = "webhook"
  url            = "https://hooks.example.com/sustain"
  url_wo_version = 1
}

# Every contact at once, and the channel if it's still down after five minutes.
resource "sustain_alert_policy" "shop" {
  name          = "Shop"
  channel_ids   = [sustain_alert_channel.hook.id]
  delay_seconds = 0
  escalation    = [{ after_seconds = 300, channel_ids = [sustain_alert_channel.hook.id] }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `channel_ids` (List of String) The channels it alerts, or null for every one.
- `client_ids` (List of String) The clients it applies to, their services and monitors no policy lists, in the same way.
- `client_recipient_ids` (List of String) Enterprise's: a client's own people it alerts, each confirmed by email first, by Sustain's ids for them.
- `contact_ids` (List of String) The alert contacts it alerts, or null for every one.
- `critical_only_out_of_hours` (Boolean) A rule, Enterprise's: out of a client's support hours, only its critical services page; the rest go to its chat and webhook channels and its contacts alone.
- `delay_seconds` (Number) How long a monitor must stay down before anyone is alerted.
- `escalation` (Attributes List) Its later steps, in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--escalation))
- `in_hours_channel_ids` (List of String) The channels it tells instead in a client's support hours.
- `in_hours_client_recipient_ids` (List of String) A client's own people it tells instead in a client's support hours.
- `in_hours_contact_ids` (List of String) A rule, Enterprise's: the alert contacts it tells instead, paging no one, in a client's support hours; none for no such rule.
- `monitor_ids` (List of String) The monitors it applies to, taken from any other policy; none for the default, which has the rest.
- `notify_recovery` (Boolean) Whether recoveries are sent, or left out.
- `page_major_only` (Boolean) A rule, Enterprise's: only a major outage pages; a partial outage or a degradation goes to its chat and webhook channels and its contacts alone.
- `remind_limit` (Number) How many reminders at most, or null for every one until someone takes it or it recovers.
- `remind_seconds` (Number) How often to remind while it stays down; null for never.
- `schedule_ids` (List of String) The on-call schedules whose person on call it alerts too.
- `service_ids` (List of String) The services it applies to, and their monitors no policy lists, in the same way.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO 8601 time in UTC.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_default` (Boolean) The default has every monitor and service no other policy lists, and can't be deleted.

<a id="nestedatt--escalation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `escalation`

Required:

- `after_seconds` (Number) How long after the step before.

Optional:

- `channel_ids` (List of String)
- `contact_ids` (List of String)
- `even_if_acknowledged` (Boolean) Whether it goes even once someone has taken the incident: to tell someone, rather than to wake them.
- `schedule_ids` (List of String) The on-call schedules whose person on call it alerts.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By its id in Sustain, as its page in the console, or its API, gives it.
terraform import sustain_alert_policy.shop <id>
```
